description: This test file contains pytest test cases for a FastAPI application, testing an XML response and the OpenAPI schema endpoint. It imports modules for dynamic import, pytest fixtures, and FastAPI test client, defining a fixture to initialize the test client from a dynamically imported app module and two test functions for API endpoints.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a module and initializes a FastAPI TestClient for testing API endpoints.

methods.name: test_path_operation(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that sends a GET request to the '/legacy/' endpoint and validates the XML response content and headers.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that retrieves the OpenAPI JSON schema from '/openapi.json' and verifies its structure and content.
